_about: ORRERY (Room Review round 22, Josh 2026-10-09): a cone of golden light from the opening in the ceiling (orr_top, the octagonal shaft at y 330..406) enveloping the orrery, deep dust floating in it (ORRERY/2, /7); four soft glowing blobs on the floor, deep orange and flickering, drifting slowly round orange, orange-purple, orange-red and red-blue (ORRERY/3-6); light fog and bounce light throughout.
_embers: no sparks off the blobs (Josh, round 23: no particle effects on them) -- null does NOT turn embers off (a missing block means the default embers); rate 0 does

dust._about: round 25 (Josh): much more varied floating dust through the room (the everywhere class had 500 at 0.3-1.3)

volume._about: light fog (Josh: 'apply the fog to this room but lightly')
volume._round23: Josh: dark room mist to fill the gaps the golden light does not reach; every light cuts through it (lightThrough / lightThroughAir)

gi._about: bounce light throughout (Josh, ORRERY/2): the golden cone carries most of it, so bounce 1.2 on it; first pass (power 2.2, bounce 2, strength 2.5, air 18) washed the whole room gold
gi._ambient: round 28 (Josh): the room's base level 0.5 -> 0.8 (it had halved the room before any light)

lights.name: golden light from the ceiling (ORRERY/2, /7)
lights._placed: in the ceiling's octagonal shaft (orr_top x -84..88, z -85..87, y 330..406), over the orrery's middle (orr_collap x -79..109, z -84..109); straight down, a cone wide enough to take in most of the orrery (16/22 degrees: about 110 / 160 across at the floor)
lights._cone: round 23 (Josh): about 30% narrower -- 16/22 -> 11/16 degrees (about 77 / 112 across at the floor)
lights._round25: Josh: brightness insane -- the same level as CORICORI's ceiling shaft (power 0.45, air 26, bounce 3), colour kept. Matched: power 0.5 (its 900 range dims it ~15% more than the shaft's 3000 at this height), air 9 (the cone is ~2.8x wider, so a line of sight crosses ~2.8x more lit air: 26 / 2.8), bounce 3 as the shaft. airFirst: the four blobs nearby can no longer push it out of the fog (that is what made it vanish at air 9 before)

dust._round27: Josh: more natural and much slower -- the turn 0.35 -> 0.03 rad/s (at the beam's edge it had been ~17 units/s), and each speck now eases along a slow smooth drift (under 1 unit/s) instead of jittering
dust._round26: Josh: like bokeh dust swirling in the beam, bottom to top, not so large -- from the light itself down (fromLight: the first surface below is the orrery, not a ceiling), turning round the axis at ~0.2-0.5 rad/s and rising/sinking, sizes 0.3x-1.65x of 0.7 (was up to 3x of 1.0)

lights.name: ethereal blob by the north door (ORRERY/3)
lights._placed: 25 above the floor (y 4.55) at Josh's point; no torch, all round, soft, glowing in the fog (air 3)
lights._flicker: round 27 (Josh): no flicker -- only the slow breathing of the colour cycle
lights._round24: Josh: spread only across the floor ring it sits on (between the orrery pit, about 87 out, and the walls, about 165): 12 above the floor, reach 38, glow 32; bounce 0, so its colour no longer spreads through the room by the bounced light
